title: Can I BEAT King of the Bridge? (Impatience Award)
summary: The creator replays the indie game King of the Bridge (a pixel-art chess game against a cheating Troll guarding a bridge) to earn the 'Impatience' achievement for completing the game in under 15 minutes, with a speedrun timer top-left. He skips the Troll's intro dialogue, shuffles pawns waiting for the Troll to cheat, and accuses each cheat by selecting the correct rule from a rule book. A false accusation (wrong rule) loses immediately, which costs him the first attempt; the second run finishes at 10:20 and earns the award (he had mistakenly targeted 10 minutes, which is the separate 'Rush' achievement).
rules: Play chess against the Troll, who regularly cheats (illegal moves).
When the Troll cheats you open the rule book and accuse the offending piece citing the exact rule broken; a correct accusation removes/punishes the cheating piece ('Scadoodle').
False accusation (wrong rule or no rule broken) = you lose immediately.

Game-specific rules from the rule book, e.g.: Rule 2 - you may not move the opponent's pieces; Rule 4 - pawns cannot move diagonally (except capture); Rule 7 - a 'troubled' knight moves as dictated; Rule 25 - only bishops may move 'out of town' (off the board edge); pieces may move back in from out of town.
Pawns can move/capture backwards in this game.
Bishops can create 'gifts' (pickups placed on squares); a piece dropped onto a gift / capturing with the gift gives an effect (capturing the king with the gift ends it).
Capturing the Troll's king does not end the game: the king 'transfers his royal guard' to another piece.
The queen may not capture the king ('royal affair' rule).
Pieces can be knocked over and must be 'stood back up' (taking a move).
Board flips at times. A goose can appear as a distraction.
If you lose your own king the game is over.
You win when all of the Troll's pieces are gone.
win_condition: Eliminate all of the Troll's pieces (then end sequence where you become the troll). Achievement: finish in under 15 minutes total game time.
